responsibility: Read KANDA_FREEZE_HINT.json sidecars from staged patch ZIPs, normalize both flat and nested patch-boundary metadata into complete freeze-form inputs, repair legacy saved form records from the raw hint when needed, merge post-validation evidence after local validation passes, safely remove stale LOCAL VALIDATION PENDING wording once real local validation markers exist, and provide mandatory-field-safe freeze-form inputs to the Freeze Feature After Update tab before heuristic fallback.
fallback_behavior: If no valid KANDA_FREEZE_HINT.json is available, the Freeze Feature After Update tab keeps its deterministic heuristic baseline. If a valid hint exists but saved form_inputs are stale, blank, or placeholder-filled, the intake contract re-derives mandatory form fields from the raw hint instead of leaking starter placeholders.
